title: pinus occidentalis subsp. baorucoensis
intro: Pinus occidentalis subsp. baorucoensis, commonly known as the Hispaniolan pine, is a subspecies of pine tree native to the island of Hispaniola in the Caribbean. This plant has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, including respiratory problems, due to its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Pinus occidentalis subsp. baorucoensis are attributed to its ability to soothe coughs, reduce fever, and promote wound healing. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
